name: Brethren of the Bolt
inspire:
Each friendly fighter starts the game Inspired.

Immediately after an Action step in which a friendly fighter was a conducting fighter, Inspire that fighter.

Uninspire
Immediately after a friendly fighter's successful Attack, Uninspire that friendly fighter.

reactions.name: Holy Capacitors
reactions.rulesText: Subtract 1 from the distance between a friendly attacker and their target for each friendly fighter between the attacker and the target. Those friendly fighters are conducting.

abilities.name: Fulminating Hymn
abilities.flavorText: The chants of the Brethren seems to spark holy lightning.
abilities.rulesText:
Pick one of the following abilities at the start of the combat phase. While there are two or more friendly fighters, each fighter can use that ability.

Charged Aura: Friendly fighters cannot be Flanked.

Reckless Abandon: Each time a friendly fighter would be given a Charge token, you can inflict 1 damage on that fighter instead of giving them a Charge token.

Faithful Dynamos: Friendly fighter's weapons have Stagger ({icon:stagger}).

abilities.name: Crackling Burst
abilities.trigger: Use this in a Power step.
abilities.flavorText: Filled with zealous dynamism, the Brethren advance.
abilities.rulesText: Pick a friendly fighter. That fighter Moves. You can only use this ability once per game.

abilities.name: Heaven's Charge
abilities.trigger: Use this immediately after your Action step.
abilities.flavorText: Chanting, the cultists 'share' their electrical boon.
abilities.rulesText: Pick a friendly fighter. Uninspire that fighter, then inflict 1 damage on an adjacent enemy fighter. You can only use this ability once per game.

abilities.name: Coruscating Revival
abilities.trigger: Use this immediately after your Action step.
abilities.flavorText: The kiss of lightning invigorates the brethren.
abilities.rulesText: Pick a friendly fighter that was conducting during that step. Heal that fighter. You can only use this ability once per game.

playstyle: Five fragile Sigmarite zealots with modest Move and low Health, the Brethren start Inspired but lose it after each successful Attack. Holy Capacitors lets friendly fighters standing between an attacker and its target shorten the distance, and those conducting fighters become Inspired again, so the band forms chains to strike from surprising range. A chosen hymn prevents Flanking, grants Stagger or lets fighters take damage instead of Charge tokens. The warband wins by holding tight formations, cycling Inspiration and overwhelming foes with coordinated reach.
